name: Password Reset
description: Forced Password Reset Policy every 30 days.

name: ORM
description: Upgrade the platform's SQL queries to use an ORM.

name: Two-Factor Authentication
description: Mandatory Two-Factor Authentication

name: Principle of Least Privilege
description: Ensure users and systems only have the permissions strictly necessary for their functions.

name: Periodic Access Review
description: Regular audit of user accounts to disable access for former employees and remove excessive privileges.

name: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
description: Implementation of WAF to filter malicious HTTP/HTTPS traffic and mitigate web attacks like SQLi and XSS.

name: Network Segmentation
description: Dividing the network into isolated subnets to contain lateral movement of attackers if an asset is compromised.

name: Mandatory VPN (Remote Access)
description: Require connection via VPN with strong encryption for any administrative access to internal systems.

name: Encryption in Transit (TLS)
description: Ensure all network communications use strong encryption protocols like TLS 1.2 or higher.

name: Encryption at Rest
description: Encryption of databases and backups to protect sensitive data in case of physical theft of disks or servers.

name: Strict Input Validation
description: Implementation of rigorous validation on all user-supplied data to prevent code injections.

name: Continuous Patch Management
description: Scheduled process to quickly apply security updates to operating systems and software libraries.

name: Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
description: Use of automated tools in the development pipeline to detect security flaws in the code before deployment.

name: Centralized Log Management
description: Collection of system and application logs to a secure central server to facilitate auditing and incident response.

name: Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
description: Implementation of advanced security software on workstations and servers to detect anomalous behaviors.

name: Incident Response Plan
description: Maintenance and regular testing of a documented plan that dictates the exact steps to take in case of a security breach.

name: Anti-Phishing Training
description: Annual training and practical phishing simulations to educate employees not to fall for social engineering.

name: Offline and Immutable Backups
description: Creation of backups that cannot be altered or deleted by the main network to mitigate ransomware attacks.

name: Disable Unnecessary Ports and Services
description: Closing of unnecessary network ports and disabling of non-essential services on servers.

name: Account Lockout Policy
description: Automatic account lockout policy after a set number of failed login attempts to protect against brute force attacks.

name: Enterprise Password Manager
description: Provision and mandatory use of a password vault to prevent employees from reusing credentials.
